scope: Real Windows normal connection Owner reconciles local compromise/retirement with native transport and persisted preferences
assertions: Existing actual two-Owner bidirectional/offline/restart/replay phases remain required
Compromised decision selects the exact verified nonzero peer boundary and nonzero content hash
Daemon journal confirmation and canonical writer run under the adapter-equivalent admission/rebuild boundary
Previously issued native status reader loses authority
Normal Owner reconciles to no eligible peers and AddressNeeded, never ReadyLocally
Old endpoint preferences are refused as UnknownDevice and cannot restore peer authority
LAN TCP listener is no longer reachable after removal of the final peer
Accepted pre-cutoff peer note remains available through guarded search
Restart preserves the restricted roster, rejects the same stale settings and preserves sealed and active canonical bytes
Self-retirement stops local transport and reports Attention/LocalRestricted with no ready reader
Retired restart and stale settings cannot reactivate transport; immutable sealed bytes and append-only active history are preserved

initial_failure.phase: After live compromise reconciliation, stale-settings refusal, LAN listener closure and retained search passed
initial_failure.cause: Test counted only sealed .seg files; a security append may remain in the durable .open pack with the final peer removed
initial_failure.correction: Include active packs for security snapshots; require exact restart equality, immutable sealed bytes, appended retirement evidence and preserved active prefixes. No forced sealing or production policy change.

second_fixture_failure.error: AlreadyRunning { holder_pid: None } at instance reopen
second_fixture_failure.cause: Test retained the deliberately revoked StatusReader across restart; its original transport guard retains the instance exclusion even though readiness is invalid
second_fixture_failure.correction: Drop the old reader after asserting it has no authority, before reopening a new Owner. No lock bypass, forced unlock or production change.

checked: Windows owner confirmation invalidates derived admission before append, including uncertain outcomes
Controller derives active peers from a locked canonical scan; saved endpoints cannot create authority
Controller drains old owned worker before replacement and latches unresolved shutdown
Old native status readers reject invalid admission generations
Incoming normal pump uses the retained instance, guards pause/hold and delegates signatures/cutoff/publication to the existing controller
Settings and native profile UI do not promote local readiness/publication to remote durability
not_closed: Terminal self-retirement propagation: writer can leave the event in an active pack, while ExchangePeers rejects LocalRestricted and the normal exporter requires eligible peers; local stop/restart success does not demonstrate delivery of the terminal event. This is also explicitly excluded by M8_SEALED_EXPORT_CHECKPOINT.md.
Legacy replication status CLI remains metadata diagnostics with static NotImplemented fields; not an integrated runtime report
Final candidate-wide security and human review

limits: One disposable Windows CI host, real managed transport and synthetic identities; no owner profile modification
Security journal confirmation is a daemon test seam, not authenticated Desktop approval
Restriction is local and the opposite peer is stopped before it; this does not prove restriction propagation over the physical Windows-Mac link
Mac writer and shared renderer checks do not establish Mac native security-transition parity
No Protected state or signed remote receipt protocol introduced
Actual-device digest, interruption, restriction propagation and final review remain separate M8 gates
